class Shop {
  static items = ["apple", "pear"];
  static total = Shop.items.length;
  static label = `${this.total} items`;
  static later = () => Shop.discount;
  static describe = function () {
    return `${Shop.label} at ${Shop.discount}% off`;
  };
  static discount = 10;
  static first = Shop.pick(0);
  static pick(index: number): string {
    return Shop.items[index];
  }
  static {
    console.log("static block sees", Shop.total, this.discount);
  }
  count = Shop.total;
  price = this.base * 2;
  get base(): number {
    return 3;
  }
  doubled = (): number => this.tax * 2;
  tax = 5;
}

console.log(Shop.label, Shop.later(), Shop.describe(), Shop.first);
const shop = new Shop();
console.log(shop.count, shop.price, shop.doubled());
